name: dsh-matlab-simulink
description: Drive a locally installed MATLAB/Simulink from DSH tools: run .m scripts and inline code, simulate .slx models with block-parameter overrides, and export publication-quality (300 DPI / vector PDF) figures into the conversation.

requires.matlab: R2023a or newer for -batch and exportgraphics

tools.name: matlab_status
tools.summary: Report the resolved MATLAB/Simulink installation, how it was discovered, and optionally verify that it launches and list installed toolboxes.

tools.name: matlab_run_script
tools.summary: Run an existing .m script headlessly and collect the figures and data files it produces.

tools.name: matlab_run_code
tools.summary: Run MATLAB code directly, with any figure left open exported using academic styling.

tools.name: simulink_run_model
tools.summary: Load a Simulink model, override StopTime and block parameters, simulate, and export logged signals as MAT and CSV.

tools.name: matlab_export_figure
tools.summary: Re-render an existing figure at a new size, DPI, font, or format to satisfy journal requirements.
